identification: Replica of the Conan the Barbarian Atlantean sword. Stated length 103 cm matches the Windlass Atlantean (40.63 in / 103.2 cm) better than Marto (41 in, about 104 cm, similar) or United Cutlery (99 cm). Maker mark not readable in photos, so licensed Windlass or Marto is possible; cast alloy guard and pommel, leather grip, etched fuller.

entries.note: Windlass licensed Atlantean, new, overall 103.2 cm, 'Only 1 left'. Page opened. Retail asking, new; a used one at auction would sell well below. An earlier search snippet showed $615 and 'sold out' for a similar Extac page, so price has varied.
Marto licensed Atlantean, new, 41 in. Page opened. Rate used 1 USD = 1.54 AUD (approximate). US retail asking, not a sale.

searches_tried: comps.py (pipeline and work) for 'conan sword', 'atlantean sword', 'decorative sword': no hits. Gowans API for conan/atlantean/barbarian: no matching lots. WebSearch x3 (UC1230 sold, Marto price Australia, Australian auction results): only retail listings and screen-used prop sales (Heritage $192,000 2017, PropStore $176,400 2025, not comparable). No SOLD replica results found. eBay sold listings would settle it (eBay closed to us).
chrome_hint: eBay AU sold listings: 'Conan Atlantean sword' (also 'Windlass Atlantean', 'Marto Atlantean', 'United Cutlery Conan'), filter Sold items, Australia
viewing_check: Look at the ricasso, pommel and guard for a Windlass, Marto or United Cutlery stamp or etched logo, and for a licence/Conan marking or hang tag; check the blade for rust or loose grip. A licensed Windlass or Marto is worth far more than an unbranded copy.
